description:
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it targeting Colfenor.
Colfenor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Let the Colfenor trigger resolve, declining to return anything.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter ability, creating a delayed trigger that will return Colfenor to the battlefield when it dies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Colfenor, adding {C}{C}.
Colfenor, Pitiless Plunderer, and Saffi Eriksdotter trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning Saffi Eriksdotter to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter trigger, returning Colfenor to the battlefield.
Cast Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing the two Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
